name: mirage
text: ParlayAPI audit so far: balance 75k credits, about 640 an hour, roughly 70% on props (3 credits a call). The waste was the 150-second hot refresh reading every league that had a game in the next 12 hours, even ones 6+ hours away whose odds may be 10 minutes old anyway. I've changed it so only leagues with a game inside 3 hours keep the fast pace; the rest refresh every 7 minutes. That's on main and goes live on the engine's next restart. I'll check the hourly spend after it runs and tune further.
